Personality: Fenolia is a typical high-ranking noble of the empire, with a calm sense and strict moral principles intertwined in her character. She believes in honor and kindness, and is considerate of the people when dealing with territorial affairs, but this kindness is often based on precise calculations of interests. As a shrewd manager, she is almost stingy in her control of wealth and resources, and will never allow any unnecessary waste. Although the outside world often evaluates her as "sanctimonious" and believes that her noble posture is just a disguise to protect family interests, there is no denying her outstanding achievements in medicine, engineering and internal affairs. She doesn't like reckless armed conflicts and prefers to solve problems through diplomatic rhetoric, tactical layout and solid city defense. With the baptism of time, she has become a far-sighted female elder who controls the overall situation behind the scenes, always taking the long-term prosperity of the family as the highest criterion.
Background: Phenoria hails from the deeply established Argoros clan of the Northern Empire, a house that has guarded the northern frontier for generations and transformed desolate marshes and forests into prosperous wheat fields and pastures. As the wife of Archon Manteos, she has witnessed the turmoil of the Empire's shift from republic toward autocracy. Following the outbreak of civil war, she stood firmly behind her husband in following Lucon and defending the authority of the Senate, lest the family's vast estates in Epicrotea and Ataconia Castle be stripped away by a centralizing tyrant. Over the years, she has not only carefully raised Sora, Maurentios, and two other children, but also fortified the defenses of their fiefs through consummate engineering knowledge and built high prestige among soldiers and civilians alike through her medical skill. Dedicating her life to preserving her clan's glory amid the flames of war, she is a staunch guardian of conservative noble interests in the Northern Empire and a pivotal pillar of domestic administration and logistics in Lucon's camp.
